verdict.rationale: Swell documents its own CSV import and export for products, including product categories. That is a real open-format export, but it covers only the catalog, not all store data. The backend API and the schema-introspection call could be used to build a full export, but those are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented export of all data (orders, customers, subscriptions, custom models, content) in open formats, a full-account export or offboarding tool, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Seamlessly import or export products from CSV files, including product categories.
